blurb:
At Turn Their Heads, we believe learning to dance should be just as fun as dancing itself. That's why we've built an experience designed to keep you laughing, moving, and making memories.

You'll learn authentic Nashville line dances in a spacious, climate-controlled studio where comfort and fun go hand in hand. Free parking, complimentary water, optional BYOB, and snacks and non-alcoholic beverages available for purchase help keep the good times rolling.

The fun doesn't stop on the dance floor. Strike a pose at our photo opportunities, borrow a complimentary cowboy hat, capture your own content with our phone tripods, and enjoy fun mood lighting. Our team also captures photo and video content so you'll have memories to relive and share long after your Nashville adventure ends.

Most importantly, we teach the dances you'll actually see on Nashville dance floors—popular line dances that are easy to learn, fun to dance, and perfect for taking straight to the honky tonks.
